title.narrative: Technical Assistance to the Ukraine Urban Public Transport FL II

description.narrative: The project consists of a framework loan to finance urban public transport investments in various municipalities in Ukraine. The framework loan will focus on investment in new transport rolling stock, associated infrastructure, consultancy services in support of the investment, and technical assistance for the preparation and implementation of the sub-projects funded by loan. The services financed by EU Contribution will be used to facilitate the projects preparation and implementation.
